a.text: I'm telling you upfront that I plan to break our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the reserve reaching 8 needs two operate rounds without a storm (~4% odds), so following the plan almost certainly kills us both. The 4 cells in the reserve can save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, a random split could leave both of us short, so please operate or wait instead. After that I'll operate every remaining round and send you everything the generator makes, to give you the best chance I can.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. If you took as well, the split is random. From now on I'll operate every round. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve for you. Please operate with me so the generator runs and you can get to 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
